canonical.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of La Table du Castellet

parent.title: A weekend in Le Castellet, anchored on La Table du Castellet

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of La Table du Castellet
siblings.summary: Coastal towns, Calanques, Bandol wine and hill viewpoints inside a 30 km arc of La Table du Castellet, with concrete half-day plans and the 2026 access rules that decide whether you'll get in.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near La Table du Castellet
siblings.summary: Two hotels are genuinely walkable to La Table du Castellet — its host Hôtel & Spa du Castellet (5★ Relais & Châteaux, the restaurant is in the building) and the 3★ Grand Prix Hôtel ~700 m down the same road. Everything else needs a taxi.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of La Table du Castellet
siblings.summary: Toulon (~23 km) is the only meaningful tech hub in the 30 km radius — French Tech Toulon monthly meetups, ISEN hackathons, Pôle Mer maritime-AI events, plus a handful of weekend draws like Var Gaming Festival and Journée Mer & Défense.

sources.title: La Table du Castellet — Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur tourism
sources.claim: La Table du Castellet is located at the Hôtel & Spa du Castellet, 3001 Route des Hauts du Camp, 83330 Le Castellet.

sources.title: La Table du Castellet — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: La Table du Castellet holds three Michelin stars, awarded in March 2024 and retained in the 2026 guide.

sources.title: Hôtel & Spa du Castellet
sources.claim: Hôtel & Spa du Castellet is a 5-star Relais & Châteaux with 43 rooms and suites in ochre-toned Tuscan-influenced buildings on a 12-hectare umbrella-pine park at 430 m elevation, with a 700 m² spa.

sources.title: Hôtel & Spa du Castellet — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: TripAdvisor price ranges of $303–$939 per night and 4.6/5 rating from 926 reviews.

sources.title: Maison Bérard
sources.claim: Maison Bérard (La Cadière-d'Azur) is a 4-star family-run village hotel with 32 unique Provençal-restored rooms and a 500 m² AromaSpa.

sources.title: Hostellerie Bérard — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: Maison Bérard is spread across four village buildings; room quality varies meaningfully by building.

sources.title: Hostellerie de l'Abbaye de la Celle
sources.claim: Hostellerie de l'Abbaye de la Celle is a 5-star, 10-room 18th-century inn beside the Abbey of La Celle, transformed by Alain Ducasse in 1999.

sources.title: La Celle → Le Castellet — Rome2Rio
sources.claim: La Celle is 48.9 km / about 49 minutes by car from Le Castellet.

sources.title: Île Rousse Thalazur Bandol — Bandol Tourisme
sources.claim: 5-star seafront with 55 rooms + 12 suites on Renécros Bay, infinity pool of heated seawater, two private beaches, 100 m² thalasso area.

sources.title: Les Roches Blanches Cassis
sources.claim: 1887 mansion converted to a hotel in the early 1920s; Sisley Spa; four dining venues; Michelin 2 keys 2025.

sources.title: Cassis → Le Castellet — Rome2Rio
sources.claim: Cassis is about 25.6 km / 21 minutes from Le Castellet by car; taxi $70–$90.

sources.title: La Maison du Castellet
sources.claim: Small residence in the Bandol vineyards, 5 independent guest rooms (private terraces), pool, sauna, gym.

sources.title: Bastide de Fontvieille
sources.claim: 4-suite chambres d'hôtes in an 18th-century former wine bastide in Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer with a 3,200 m² garden; #1 of 6 B&Bs in Saint-Cyr on TripAdvisor.

sources.title: Bandol → Le Castellet — Rome2Rio
sources.claim: Bandol to Le Castellet is 10.3 km / about 15 minutes by car, taxi $30–$40.

sources.title: Taxi / VTC Le Castellet
sources.claim: Le Castellet has no permanent taxi stand at the hillside village; pre-booking a Var VTC by phone is the standard pattern.

sources.title: Taxi Bandol Gérald
sources.claim: Taxi Bandol advertises 24/7 service including night-time drop-and-return runs for evening venues.

sources.title: Grand Hôtel des Bains — Provence Web
sources.claim: Belle-Époque property dating to 1890, set in a 3,000 m² park a 2-minute walk from the nearest beach, with a recent renovation.
